source_refs.note: 2- Cannabis: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 48-48.

blocks.text: Cannabis ek psychoactive drug hai jo Indian hemp (bhang) ke poday Cannabis sativa ke sookhe phool wale siron, patton aur tane se banti hai. Is mein marijuana aur hashish (charas) jaisi drugs shamil hain. Ise dhuein, bhaap (vapour) ya khane ki cheezon mein liya ja sakta hai. Cannabis ka istemal sukoon, sarsoor, badli hui samajh (altered perception) aur zyada bhook ka ehsas deta hai. Is ka lamba istemal bure asraat laata hai, jaise soch samajh (cognitive function) ki kharabi, saans ke masail aur zehni bimariyan.
